_how_to: The little notes behind the heart. Edit this file on GitHub (github.com/farmansyah/afra/blob/main/static/notes.json,
pencil icon, then Commit). Installed copies of A.F.R.A pick up the change within about 10 minutes, no update needed.
per_open: how many notes one click shows (1 = one note, 3 = three, 0 = every note that is on).
order: shuffle = every note once before any repeats | random = any note, any time | in_order = top to bottom | newest = from the bottom up.
only: list of note ids to show for now (e.g. ["n03", "n07"]); empty = every note whose "on" is true.
pin: id of a note that always comes first (e.g. on her birthday); empty = none.
Each note: id (unique), on (true/false), text, and optional title (replaces the main title for that note),
from / until (dates like 2026-12-24) so a note only appears on those days.
title: For Raina Afra

notes.text: This little app carries your name. I built it so your long research nights feel a little lighter, and so every paper you finish has someone quietly cheering you on.
Every reference in your library is a small step you took. I hope you can see how far all those small steps have already carried you.
If the deadline feels loud tonight, take one breath, then one paragraph. You have done hard things before, and you did them beautifully.
Semangat, sayang. Tugas ini cuma satu halaman dari cerita panjangmu, dan aku senang bisa membaca setiap babnya bersamamu.
You are allowed to stop for water, for food, for a short walk. The words will still be here, and so will I.
Some people collect stamps. You collect questions, and then you chase them until they become answers. I love watching you do that.
Behind every finished document there is a version of you that almost gave up and didn't. Thank you for being stubborn in all the right ways.
I can't write your paper for you, but I can build you a place to write it, keep your coffee warm, and remind you that you are very, very good at this.
When you finally press export and the Word file opens, take a second to be proud. I already am.
Kalau capek, istirahat dulu. Kamu tidak harus selesai hari ini untuk tetap jadi orang hebat.
A messy first draft is not a failure. It is the first time your idea exists outside your head. That's how every good thing begins.
Your curiosity is my favourite thing to watch in the world. Never let a deadline make you forget how much you love learning.
I put this note here so that on the days nobody says it, the app does: you are doing better than you think.
Somewhere in this library is a sentence you will be proud of for years. Keep going until you find it.
Whatever the grade, whatever the reviewer says, the person who worked this hard is the one I'm proud of.
If you're reading this at 2 a.m., please go to sleep. If you're reading this at 2 p.m., you're doing great, carry on.
Terima kasih sudah sabar dengan dunia, dengan tugas-tugasmu, dan dengan aku. Aku selalu di sini.
Every time you open A.F.R.A, I hope it feels a bit like being handed a cup of tea and told: you've got this.
Big projects are just small days stacked carefully. Today only needs to be one good day.
When this one is done, let's celebrate properly. You choose the place; I'll bring the applause.
